narrative.overview: The site is a ledger, not a brochure. Every claim sits in a row with its evidence in the same glance, and the page is built from full-width slabs of pure black and pure white that alternate by section. There is no accent colour, no shadow and no illustration: state is carried by three squares, and the mark is a pair of ears.
keyCharacteristics: Strictly black and white; no accent colour.
Alternating slabs (.on-paper, .on-ink) that swap the semantic palette in scope.
One marker system, three squares, always labelled.

rules.name: The Slab Rule
rules.body: A section is on-paper or on-ink, never a tint between; components read variables, never literal colours.

rules.name: The No Accent Rule
rules.body: There is no hue. Emphasis is weight, size, underline thickness or a marker.

rules.name: The Not By Colour Rule
rules.body: State is never carried by colour alone; every state has a shape and a word.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only on figures, code, logs and table heads.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Tables and measurements use tabular numerals; numeric columns align right.

rules.name: The Verdict Row Rule
rules.body: A claim never appears without its evidence in the same row, linked.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Rows and sections are separated by a 1px hairline; the head of a ledger takes a 1px solid ink rule.

dos: Do alternate .on-paper and .on-ink slabs and let variables do the theming.
Do pair every marker with a label and every row with a link to its file.
Do keep "QEMU TCG, an emulator" beside every benchmark figure, and call ENOSYS unavailable (hatch), never protection.
Do keep text out of the corner where the seam ears reach.
donts: Don't add a hue, a shadow or a gradient to the chrome.
Don't use a card grid under a slogan, or big-number metric blocks.
Don't use mono for prose or headings.
Don't use circles or colour for state.
